title: Hello Robot Sets the Standard for Practical, Safe Home Robots
summary: Many roboticists (and at least one robotics journalist) have been seduced by the dream of a robot butler. And the rampant popularity of videos showing humanoid robots doing household tasks in improbably clean kitchens and unrealistically tidy bedrooms suggests that we’re not the only ones interested in a robot that can do our chores. But for all kinds of reasons, legged humanoids are not yet ready for industrial or commercial applications at scale, and home applications (if people even want them), I would argue, are even farther away. Even so, ludicrously well-funded humanoid robotics companies are now ramping production while explicitly promising that their robots will be doing ‘housework.’

title: House passes One Big Beautiful Bill with 100% bonus depreciation for automation equipment

title: Wi-Fi That Can Withstand a Nuclear Reactor

Total raised across the Series A and extension reaches $935 million. Apptronik has commercial partnerships with Google DeepMind, GXO Logistics, and Mercedes-Benz.

summary: Pursuant to the Bayh-Dole Act and implementing regulations, the Department of the Air Force hereby gives notice of its intent to grant a partially exclusive, the field to include foreign object debris detection on paved surfaces, patent license to Airtrek Robotics, Inc. having a place of business at 2900 Reading Road, Cincinnati, OH 45206.

title: Petition for Reconsideration of Action in Rulemaking Proceeding Application for Review of Action in Rulemaking Proceeding
summary: Petition for Reconsideration (Petition) has been filed in the Commission's proceeding by Travis LeBlanc on behalf of SZ DJI Technology Co., Ltd. Application for Review (AFR) has been filed in the Commission's proceeding by Fan Liang, Zhiyu Liang on behalf of Autel Robotics Co., Ltd.

title: National Commission on Robotics Act introduced in House
summary: Rep. Jay Obernolte (R-CA) introduced H.R. 7334, the National Commission on Robotics Act, directing the Department of Commerce to establish an 18-member commission of recognized robotics experts. The Commission would submit an interim report within one year and a final report with actionable recommendations on U.S. robotics competitiveness within two years.

title: Global humanoid installations reach 16,000 units as commercial deployments accelerate
summary: Global humanoid robot installations reached roughly 16,000 units in 2025, with China accounting for over 80% of that total. TrendForce forecasts a growth of up to 94% in Chinese humanoid robot production by 2026 as commercialization accelerates in the second half of the year. Unitree Robotics and AgiBot could together account for nearly 80% of the country's shipments.

title: Unitree targets 20,000 humanoid shipments in 2026
summary: Unitree plans to ship up to 20,000 humanoid robots in 2026, a significant jump from 2025 shipments of more than 5,500 units. Unitree's revenue from humanoids surpassed quadruped revenue for the first time in 2025, representing over 51% of the total. The company plans to reach an annual capacity of 75,000 humanoids over the next five years.

title: AgiBot opens humanoid mass-production facility in Shanghai
summary: Shanghai-based AgiBot opened a humanoid mass-production facility targeting thousands of units in 2026, backed by Tencent, Hillhouse, and BYD. Co-founder Peng Zhihui (known online as Zhi Hui Jun) stated production-line capacity is the determining factor for the next phase of commercial humanoid deployment.

title: Humanoid robotics raised $3.2B globally in 2025 — more than the previous six years combined
summary: Humanoid robotics companies raised $3.2 billion globally in 2025, more than the previous six years combined. The category's center of gravity remains in the US (Figure, Apptronik, 1X partially) for capital raised, but Chinese players (UBTECH, Unitree, AgiBot) lead on unit volume.

title: Skild AI raises $1.4B at $14B valuation for robotics foundation model
summary: Skild AI raised approximately $1.4 billion at a valuation above $14 billion, backed by SoftBank, Jeff Bezos, Coatue, and Lightspeed. The Pittsburgh-based startup is building a general-purpose foundation model intended to drive many robot bodies. Founders Deepak Pathak and Abhinav Gupta come from Carnegie Mellon University.

title: Notice of Request for Public Comments on Section 232 National Security Investigation of Imports of Robotics and Industrial Machinery
summary: On September 2, 2025, the Secretary of Commerce initiated an investigation to determine the effects on the national security of imports of robotics and industrial machinery. This investigation has been initiated under section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962, as amended (Section 232). Interested parties are invited to submit written comments, data, analyses, or other information pertinent to the investigation to the Department of Commerce's (Department) Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS), Office of Strategic Industries and Economic Security. This notice identifies issues on which the Department is especially interested in obtaining the public's views.

title: Figure AI closes Series C exceeding $1B at $39B post-money valuation
summary: Figure AI exceeded $1 billion in committed Series C capital at a $39 billion post-money valuation. The round reportedly includes Parkway Venture Capital, Tiger Global, Macquarie, and T-Mobile Ventures. Figure has been deploying its humanoid robots in pilot operations at BMW's Spartanburg plant since 2024.

title: Shield AI raises $240M Series F at $5.3B valuation
summary: Shield AI raised $240 million in a Series F round at a $5.3 billion valuation, with participation from Riot Ventures, Hanwha Aerospace, and L3Harris. The funding supports international expansion of its V-BAT autonomous aerial system and the Hivemind autonomy stack now deployed in Ukraine and across the Asia-Pacific.

title: Physical Intelligence open-sources π0 robot foundation model
summary: Physical Intelligence published and open-sourced π0, its foundation model for general robot control, alongside a $400M Series A at a $2.4B valuation. The open-source release contrasts with closed-model strategies pursued by Skild AI, Figure, and Tesla. Founders Sergey Levine, Chelsea Finn, and Karol Hausman come from UC Berkeley and Stanford.

title: Certain Robotic Floor Cleaning Devices and Components Thereof; Notice of Commission Decision To Vacate the Portion of Its Final Determination Relating to an Expired Patent, To Institute a Rescission Proceeding, and To Rescind the Remedial O
summary: Notice is hereby given that the U.S. International Trade Commission has determined to vacate the portion of its final determination relating to U.S. Patent No. 10,813,517 ("the '517 patent"), which has now expired, and to dismiss the related portion of the complaint. The Commission has also determined to institute a rescission proceeding and to rescind the limited exclusion order and cease and desist orders (collectively, "the remedial orders") issued in the underlying investigation which are based on the '517 patent. The rescission proceeding is terminated.

title: Amazon acquires Covariant talent and tech in non-traditional structure
summary: Amazon agreed to license Covariant's robotics foundation models and hire approximately a quarter of the company's staff, including the three co-founders. The deal mirrors similar Microsoft-Inflection and Google-Character arrangements: a non-traditional structure that captures talent and IP without a full acquisition.

title: Anduril raises $1.5B Series F at $14B valuation
summary: Defense technology company Anduril Industries raised $1.5 billion at a $14 billion valuation, led by Founders Fund with participation from Sands Capital and Fidelity. Anduril supplies autonomous defense systems to the US Department of Defense and allied militaries, with growing involvement in the DoD Replicator initiative.

title: Proposed Data Collection Submitted for Public Comment and Recommendations
summary: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), as part of its continuing effort to reduce public burden and maximize the utility of government information, invites the general public and other Federal agencies the opportunity to comment on a proposed information collection, as required by the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995. This notice invites comment on a proposed information collection project titled Direct Reading Methodologies, Sensors, and Robotics Technology Assessment in Lab/Simulator-based Settings. The proposed data collection will allow NIOSH to assess the safety and health considerations of these rapidly changing direct reading methods, sensor, and robotics technologies.

title: Boston Dynamics retires hydraulic Atlas, launches electric Atlas at Hyundai pilots
summary: Boston Dynamics retired its hydraulic Atlas and unveiled an all-electric Atlas designed for industrial deployments. The new platform is positioned for pilot operations at Hyundai Motor Group manufacturing plants. Boston Dynamics remains owned by Hyundai following the $1.1B 2020 acquisition.

title: Certain Robotic Floor Cleaning Devices and Components Thereof; Notice of Commission Final Determination Finding a Violation of Section 337; Issuance of a Limited Exclusion Order and Cease and Desist Orders; Termination of the Investigation
summary: Notice is hereby given that the U.S. International Trade Commission has found a violation of section 337 of the Tariff Act of 1930, as amended, in the above-captioned investigation. The Commission has issued a limited exclusion order ("LEO") prohibiting the importation of certain robotic floor cleaning devices and components thereof that are imported by or on behalf of SharkNinja Operating LLC, SharkNinja Management LLC, SharkNinja Management Co., SharkNinja Sales Co., EP Midco LLC, and SharkNinja Hong Kong Co.
